analogy.rationale: Interleukin receptors are cytokine receptors with restricted expression in these cell lines, so an IL receptor agonist should elicit little transcriptional response; other GPCR/cytokine receptor ligands acting on receptors poorly expressed in these lines are the closest analogs by expected absence of response.
